tasks.label: wails: build dev server (HMR)
tasks.detail: Builds with -tags server so the app is reachable in a real browser, where the Redux DevTools extension works. WebView2 cannot load that extension.
tasks.command: go tool wails3 task common:build:server DEV=true

tasks.label: wails: release locked binary
tasks.detail: On restart VS Code rebuilds while Delve still runs the old .exe, which Windows locks. A running .exe can be renamed but not overwritten, so move it aside instead of killing the debuggee.
tasks.command: foreach ($n in 'S3Browser','S3Browser-dev','S3Browser-server') { $exe = "build/bin/$n.exe"; $old = "$exe.old"; Remove-Item $old -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (Test-Path $exe) { Move-Item $exe $old -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; exit 0

tasks.label: vite: stop dev server
tasks.detail: Kills whatever holds the Vite dev port, so the server does not outlive the debug session.
tasks.command: $ids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5174 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($ids) { $ids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'vite dev server stopped' } else { Write-Host 'vite dev server not running' }
